_README: The registry ARMS carrier-drift.js. A withdrawal that is not in here is a withdrawal the tool
reports green on, forever — the instrument cannot tell you what has been withdrawn, only
whether registered withdrawals have propagated.
Every occurrence of a registered wording, in every carrier, must appear below with a kind and
a reason. An occurrence nobody has accounted for is RED. That is deliberate friction: the
case this exists for is a re-assertion typed into a file that already carried a correction
notice, and any rule that excuses a whole file is green on it.
kinds:
marked        the file ASSERTS the withdrawn claim and carries a strike beside it. The
marker must be present in the file or this goes red.
withdrawal    the occurrence IS the correction text, quoting the claim in order to withdraw
it. Not an assertion.
acknowledged  the claim is deliberately left standing (a dated trace inside a live file) and
the correction lives elsewhere in the same file. Requires `see`, and the
marker must be present.
mention       the wording appears but asserts nothing — a census listing carriers, a grep
command. Requires a reason that says which.
Anchors are SHORTEST-UNIQUE within the whitespace-collapsed file, generated by
`node consonance/tools/carrier-drift.js --census`. Regenerating the census is a way to see
what changed; PASTING it back with kinds filled in from nowhere is how this becomes a
silencer. Each row is a judgement someone made once and can be argued with.

_why: CH-4 is the instruction-reachable set: files BOOT.md and SOURCE.md TELL an instance to open,
which therefore teach whoever follows the instruction. Named in carrier_surface_2026-08-25.md
(9f4f888) as the channel that produced the only measured use of retired vocabulary in b7f3775.
THIS LIST IS A LABEL, NOT A FILTER. The scanned corpus stays repo-wide-minus-traces. Narrowing
the corpus to this set would drop 14 of 17 currently-registered sites — including the
lap_2026-08-23.md re-assertion this instrument was built for — and they would go silently
ABSENT rather than red, which is the false-green class.
It is re-walked on EVERY run and diffed against this list; a difference is a finding, not a
stale-list warning. So this is the registered EXPECTATION, not the live truth.
Extraction is mechanical (--ch4-walk). It is not hand-listed, because a hand-read of BOOT for
this exact set missed dev/SPINE.md, which enters at BOOT:150 ("read SPINE first; it
supersedes") and carries the most retired-vocabulary uses of any file in the set.

_refreeze_log: READ BEFORE FREEZING, per this registry's own rule: the file entered with a BLANK depth,
i.e. as a seeded brief rather than through a pointer — nothing in BOOT or SOURCE names it.
Every file in brief/ is instruction-reachable BY CONSTRUCTION: it is what a seat is handed on
waking, so it teaches whoever wakes there. THIRD_PLACE.md is the Third Place seat's whole
intake (52 lines, ac26278, by Around). Accepting it is deliberate, not a rubber stamp.
HOW IT WAS FOUND, which is the part worth keeping: NOT by anyone re-walking. The suite went
red AT ac26278 and stayed red through 6b59f50, 6101ea6 and 7a320c3 — three commits and a
handoff that both reported "JS 59 green / 0 canary" without re-running it. The instrument was
correct and unheard for four commits. Landing a brief is landing a carrier.
